prose: Startup order is load-bearing — main.ts registers every IPC handler before createWindow(), so the renderer can never race an unregistered channel.
rationale: A renderer that invokes an unregistered channel fails at runtime with no type error.

prose: The EventBus is storage-only — nothing on it starts a turn (ADR-001). `message:created` is emitted from exactly two call sites, both on ChannelRepository.
rationale: If persistence can start a turn, bulk writes and imports silently trigger agent runs.

prose: Chats are channels — since the chat→channel fold there is one repository, ChannelRepository, whose direct-channel projection serves the chat IPC surface. ChatRepository was deleted.
rationale: Two stores over one substrate is how the shapes drifted apart in the first place.

prose: One attachment table (`message_attachments`, guaranteed by migration v61).
rationale: Parallel attachment stores desynchronise; the chat surface loses vision support.

prose: Streaming has one consumer — a single app-lifetime `chat-stream` subscriber, routing by the ADR-001 envelope.
rationale: Multiple subscribers double-apply stream deltas and race on draft rows.

prose: `ai.ts` never persists. Durability is owned by the turn core's persistence policies; the streaming layer must not write.
rationale: Persistence inside the stream layer produces duplicate rows on approval-resume.

prose: Trust model — every plugin RPC funnels through one handler gated by `PermissionGate.assertPermission`.
rationale: An ungated RPC path is a sandbox escape, not a bug.
